content:
alex: Heads up — I’m seeing a small but repeatable billing spike tied to the batcher’s aggregate window when clients reconnect quickly (within ~200–800ms). Account: foo-prod. Looks like duplicate token credits get emitted.
priya: Can you share repro steps / logs? Is this streaming toolcall related or general generate paths?
alex: Repro is on streaming + toolcall interleaved. Steps: start stream -> send tools -> client reconnects (TCP reconnect) -> server replays/prefetch + aggregator coalesces with leftover chunk -> two ledger writes for the same token range. Log snippet:

```
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] session=abc123 start_offset=1024 aggregator=coalesce window_ms=500 commit_tokens=48
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] session=abc123 reconnect seen, resume_offset=1024
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] ledger.write session=abc123 offset=1024 tokens=48 provisional=false
[2026-03-20T14:12:02Z] aggregator.commit session=abc123 start_offset=1024 tokens=48
[2026-03-20T14:12:02Z] ledger.write session=abc123 offset=1024 tokens=48 provisional=false <-- duplicate
```

mario: That looks like the aggregator and resume path both trigger a commit. Where in the pipeline is the dedupe supposed to happen? I thought ledger has idempotency by write_id.
suzanne: Ledger idempotency uses `write_id` but we generate different write_ids for aggregator commit vs resume-confirm path. The root cause is that the aggregator doesn’t adopt the resumed session’s canonical resume token, so we end up with two distinct write_ids for the same offset range.
ops-bot: [alert] timeseries spike token_count > baseline (24h): +0.02% — see: https://console.internal/metrics?m=token_credit&range=24h&tag=foo-prod
priya: Quick mitigation options:
- bump aggregator grace window to 1s (reduces chance of overlap)
- make ledger writes provisional on aggregator commits, confirmed only when resume confirms
- dedupe ledger writes server-side by (session_id, offset_range) before accepting
alex: I think provisional tagging is safest: aggregator commits provisional=true; the resume/confirm path flips provisional->false and we only count non-provisional into the billing tally. That avoids changing session semantics and is backwards compatible.
mario: Rollout/UX question: if we change to provisional semantics, dashboards will show more provisional credits initially. We should add a console badge / filter for provisional vs confirmed tokens. Ops/finance will ask.
suzanne: I can own a small patch. Implementation plan:
1) aggregator: set `provisional=true` on ledger.write
2) resume/confirm path: if a ledger entry exists for (session, offset) and provisional=true => flip to provisional=false, idempotent
3) add a compact dedupe index on ledger (session, offset) to make flip cheap
4) add tests for streamer reconnect and backfill case
priya: Good. Please also add a telemetry tag: `billing.dedupe=v1` on affected writes so we can query how often the provisional->confirm path flips vs standalone aggregator commits.
alex: I ran a quick query: impact is ~0.02% of token credits in last 24h across prod. Mostly small accounts. Still want to fix to avoid growth. I’ll open a CS ticket for accounts with >0.5% drift.
mario: On rollout: suggest feature-flag gated on config `billing.provisional_commits=true` and roll to canary for 48h. Add a fallback to revert to old behavior quickly.
suzanne: Will make a PR with flag and tests. Marking QA and perf checks. Also need to coordinate with billing team for retro refunds if we discover customers were double-charged (ask finance).
priya: From dashboard side I’ll add a temporary chart showing `tokens.provisional` vs `tokens.confirmed` and a heatmap by account. That should make impact visible during canary.
alex: Perfect. Small nit: ensure we don’t hold provisional writes forever — TTL 24h then auto-confirm? Maybe 6h. Thoughts?
suzanne: TTL 6h seems reasonable; if the confirm never arrives we can auto-expire provisional->false and mark as reconciled with note. But we need to document behavior for refunds.
mario: Also add an ingest-time metric for `dedupe.flip.latency` so we can see how long provisional stays provisional on average.
alex: OK I’ll open an internal issue with the repro and add links to the PR when created. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [ticket] created: INF-2026-431 (agg-window double-write) assigned to suzanne — https://tickets.internal/INF-2026-431
priya: ack, will follow up on dashboard widgets and telemetry queries.
suzanne: PR up later today, will request reviews from mario + alex.
